# BTicino C300X Integration v1.2.1

This is a small Home Assistant integration and native C300X device-agent update.

## Fixed

- Updates the packaged native C300X device agent to `1.2.1`.
- Corrects the HACS/Home Assistant minimum version metadata to `2025.5.0`.
- Validates both the supported minimum Home Assistant version and the current
  development pin in CI.
- Cleans up setup and repair wording so user-facing messages focus on the
  required action instead of internal implementation details.
- Keeps the Home Assistant media user on the local C300X route only, without
  adding that media user to the original smartphone forwarding route.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant before testing Ring
  Call routing or media-user setup.
